item.title: Starting the blog
item.dc:creator: Milad
item.description:
I’m Milad, a software engineer mostly involved in site reliability engineering.

The motivation behind this blog includes several things.

  • First, I want to share my unique experiences with others related to my work.
  • Second, I’m a bit bored😁.
  • Third, I want to prove to myself that in the AI era, which is a fascinating time to live in, producing non-generated content is still valuable. Who knows! Let’s see how it turns out!
  • And a couple of other reasons that I’m lazy to formulate and write about!

I’ll try my best to not use AI for writing. (I’ll probably use it for generating images though! 😂)

That’s it! Let’s start!
